traceability.notes: Performance data extracted by claude-sonnet-5 reading the PDF directly (native document input), used as a fallback because the deterministic pdfplumber pipeline (summary_report_parser.py) found no per-category breakdown in this report. Model's own extraction notes: This is a qualitative (detection) method study (TRANSIA PLATE Listeria vs ISO 11290-1). The main method comparison table (Table 5, page 12) presents 6 food/environmental categories, each with sub-types (a, b, c) that were summed into category 'Total' rows - I extracted only the category Total rows (not the sub-type rows a/b/c, nor the final 'All categories' grand total row, per instructions). The report also contains a separate Inter-Laboratory Study (section 3.2) with its own sensitivity/relative trueness/FPR calculations (Table 26, page 29) for a single collaborative-study level (Level 1) - this is a different study variant (10-lab reproducibility study, not broken down by food category) and was not included in the main category table. Numeric values use comma as decimal separator in the original document; converted to standard decimal notation here.
